weak_engine_protocol.spatial_tests: nonnegative Fourier modes; real/imaginary rows, nonzero modes sqrt(2) weighted
weak_engine_protocol.temporal_test: (1-z*z)^4 on [-1,1], zero outside; analytic first derivative
weak_engine_protocol.products: 2N zero-padded real trigonometric interpolation; retain selected observed-grid Fourier modes
weak_engine_protocol.quadrature: composite degree-nine Newton-Cotes on original samples, eight subintervals per panel
weak_engine_protocol.selection: unchanged L1 path, normalized OLS debias and development forecast selection

forecast_protocol.factor_selection: fixed before new training/development generation; not family dependent
forecast_protocol.initial_interpolation: real periodic Fourier interpolation of the observed initial frame; scipy.signal.resample handles even-grid Nyquist splitting
forecast_protocol.internal_grid: Nx*factor equally spaced points on the same period, starting at the observed x[0]
forecast_protocol.solver: unchanged pde_discovery.generic_engine.forecast on the internal grid
forecast_protocol.output: direct restriction to every factor-th internal point at the original output times
forecast_protocol.scope: uniform periodic scalar autonomous constant-coefficient nine-term PDE

freeze: Method/protocol frozenbeforeformalnewtrain/dev; all120models beforegenerating9finalICs. No finalroleaccessuntilglobalfreeze, allfailuredenominators retained.
final: 360plannedforecasts fromnoisyfirstframe, cleanfutureonlyscoring, also noisyfuturemetrics, initialexcluded. Shared9ICs, not360independentexperiments.
source_quality: SeparatecalibrationIC doubleNhalfdt, relL2<=1e-5 andmaxabs<=1e-4. Keepfailure, noreplacement/no thresholdchange.

target.metric: maximum across condition means of final-trajectory relative L2; exclude initial frame
target.failure_action: target not achieved; retain failed condition

data_protocol.scale: noise_level * full-grid clean training equal-trajectory RMS

five_engine_protocol.candidate_generation: unchanged three fixed weak variants, adaptive L1, normalized OLS debias, fit once

five_engine_protocol.median_generation: training-only; group successful candidate fits by exact term-name set
five_engine_protocol.variant_deduplication: one candidate per fixed variant/support by minimum stable training candidate ID
five_engine_protocol.vector_deduplication: exact equal physical coefficient vectors within support contribute once, retaining all aliases
five_engine_protocol.median: coordinatewise median of distinct physical coefficient vectors, no development filter
five_engine_protocol.median_failure: zero or nonfinite median rejects only the new candidate; no silent term deletion
five_engine_protocol.development_predictor: fixed spectral-hard-filter first frame then resolved factor4
five_engine_protocol.development_selection: within near_factor*best+absolute_tolerance choose fewest terms, error, stable ID
five_engine_protocol.shared_scoring: score augmented denoised pool once, then independently select its original-candidate subset for denoised_weak

initial_protocol.input: one observed initial frame and its uniform periodic spatial grid only
initial_protocol.scale_band: integer modes floor(N/4) <= k < floor(N/2); DC and real Nyquist excluded
initial_protocol.rule: retain coefficients with magnitude >= threshold, always preserve DC; hard threshold only
initial_protocol.retained_modes: data dependent, no fixed physical modes and no family-specific rule
initial_protocol.phase: retained complex coefficients unchanged; irfft handles real Nyquist
initial_protocol.scale_assumption: additive spatial white Gaussian noise; upper-band majority is noise rather than signal
initial_protocol.limitations: single-frame sparse-spectrum prior; broadband signal can bias scale upward and weak physical modes can be removed
